After immigrating from Moscow to the United States with her mother, Sasha Arutyunova began using her camera to understand how migration and distance transformed her family. Wind and Other Dangers, her ongoing series photographed across Russia, Armenia, and the United States since 2008, explores family, intimacy, identity, and belonging across continents. This image, Balcony, Pompano Beach, is part of the series, now on view at Chicago’s Filter Space through November 21.
